pages.title: One file, one shop
pages.text: Path: $(thing)data/<namespace>/shop/<shop id>.json$(). The file name is the shop id and identifies the shop — same-named files override each other.$(br2)Only two top-level fields: $(thing)title$() and $(thing)entries$().

pages.title: Entry fields
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)item$() or $(thing)tag$(): exactly one. An item id, or an item tag which expands to one entry per item.$(br)$(li)$(thing)count$(): how many items per purchase, at least 1.$(br)$(li)$(thing)price$(): the $(bold)total$() price in yuan for that purchase, not the unit price.$(br2)Entries that fail to parse are skipped and logged; the shop itself still loads.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: $(li)A shop with no valid entries does not appear at all.$(br)$(li)Item tags are bound after the reload finishes, so tag entries are expanded again on $(thing)TagsUpdatedEvent$() — if a new tag does not show up, re-enter the world or restart.$(br)$(li)To disable a shop temporarily, rename the file with a $(thing)_$() prefix.
